newsitem.title: FRANCE: Marseille air cargo traffic up 8.3 pct in July.
newsitem.headline: Marseille air cargo traffic up 8.3 pct in July.

text.p: Marseille-Provence airport said it handled 3,633 tonnes of air cargo traffic last month, an increase of 8.3 percent on July 1995.
The two key factors in traffic growth, were the increased volumes of airfreight handled by French airline, L'Aeropostale and air and road express distribution group, Jet Services.

In the first seven months of 1996, throughput at France's second biggest gateway for airfreight (after the Paris airports) totalled 25,506 tonnes, down 2.2 percent on the same period last year. - Air Cargo Newsroom tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
